title: Cobblemon: Create Industries (3D Production Models)
description: Create + Cobblemon : 3D Production of Balls, Candy, Mochi's.
body:
Cobblemon: Create Industries – A Cobblemon & Create Integration Mod

Balls 3D Models

 

Cobblemon: Create Industries

Cobblemon: Create Industries adds automated crafting recipes and industrial processes for Cobblemon items using Create mechanics.

The mod was designed to make progression feel more immersive, allowing players to manufacture Pokémon items through machines, processing, and automated production lines.

 

Current Features

  

◽ **Poké Ball Manufacturing:** Produce Poké Balls using Create’s machines and automation systems. Recipes were redesigned to provide a more immersive and industrial progression experience within Cobblemon.

◽ **Poké Ball Lid Crafting:** Poké Ball lids can be manufactured through mechanical processing using Create equipment.

◽ **Ancient Poké Balls:** Ancient Poké Balls can also be crafted using automation and mechanical processing systems.

◽ **Pokémon Candies:** Create different types of candies to strengthen and evolve your Pokémon through industrial processes.

◽ **Mochis:** Produce Mochis using automated recipes fully integrated with Create mechanics.

◽ **Cobblemon Potions:** Automate potion production using mixing, processing, and Create machinery.

 

Everything is integrated with Create’s automation and processing systems.

If you enjoy automation, factories, and Cobblemon, this mod was made to enhance your experience.

   ***

Requirements:
◽ Cobblemon
◽ Create
◽Cobblemore Lib
